subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella, or narrow the work back to existing bug-specific reports?
rationale: The source evidence supports the problem class, but the proposed solution chooses lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, persistent state, and Codex-wrapper behavior across gateway and agent surfaces that need explicit maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the maintainer-owned direction and require Track A-D to land as focused PRs with source, upgrade, and live-behavior proof.

options.title: Approve only early tracks
options.body: Treat Track A and the already-mapped Track B fixes as near-term work while deferring crash-resume and completion-drive policy.

options.title: Keep bug reports separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella and continue resolving only the narrower linked production reports independently.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the maintainer-owned direction and require Track A-D to land as focused PRs with source, upgrade, and live-behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored and self-assigned this umbrella and is already carrying the linked Track A/B implementation PRs.
